name: eink-dashboard-server
description: Server to generate dashboard images for e-ink display

scripts.build: bun scripts/gen-icons.ts && bun build public/dashboard.ts public/dashboard-week.ts --outdir=public && mkdir -p public/favicon && cp -r assets/favicon/. public/favicon/
scripts.dev: bun run build && (trap 'kill 0' EXIT; bun run build:watch & bun --watch --watch-dir ./fetchers --watch-dir ./configs server.ts)
